title: Text v2: view-mode state must stay lifted in TextNGPanel, not TextNGEditor
answers: Why does the Text panel editor's Write/Preview/Split selection reset when I add or remove a query?
Where is the default view mode for the Text v2 panel editor set?
How do I change the default view (Write/Preview/Split) for Text panel edit mode?
TextNGEditor view mode keeps resetting unexpectedly
body: Invariant: the `view` state (Write/Preview/Split) for the Text v2 editor must be owned by TextNGPanel and passed down to TextNGEditor as a controlled prop, not held as TextNGEditor's own local state. Enforced via `useState<ViewMode>` in public/app/plugins/panel/text/v2/TextNGPanel.tsx, consumed by editor/TextNGEditor.tsx. Reason: adding/removing a query toggles the frame picker, changing the tree shape and remounting the editor subtree, so locally-held state there would reset on every query change. The default value itself (now always `'split'`, previously content-dependent write/preview) is a product choice set only at this one call site - change it there, not inside TextNGEditor.
applies: public/app/plugins/panel/text/v2/** when changing panel-edit view mode behavior

Changing what the text editor defaults to on open
search: Text v2 editor view-mode state (Write/Preview/Split) must be owned by TextNGPanel.tsx via useState<ViewMode>, passed as controlled prop to TextNGEditor.tsx, not stored locally in TextNGEditor. This is enforced because adding/removing a query remounts the editor subtree, which would reset local state. The default value is always 'split' (product choice, previously content-dependent) and must be set only in TextNGPanel.tsx call site, never inside TextNGEditor. Changing view mode behavior always requires modifying public/app/plugins/panel/text/v2/TextNGPanel.tsx and public/app/plugins/panel/text/v2/editor/TextNGEditor.tsx together.
